title: Who will be Norway's reigning monarch on August 29, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Norwegian Royal House announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations. 
  Resolution Rule : Identify the person legally holding Norway's crown at the beginning of August 29, 2026, local time. Accession determines the answer, regardless of whether an oath-taking ceremony or coronation has occurred. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The sovereign's regnal name, including the ordinal.
